scenarios.reasoning: The agent followed a reasonable investigative approach — calling overview, errors, projects, properties, and search tools — but drew incorrect conclusions from the data. The most critical failure was incorrectly asserting that LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution when the rubric indicates it was NOT included. This cascading error led to a wrong root cause analysis. The agent also failed to properly list all projects and missed the configuration mismatch angle. While the error identification (MSB3030) was correct, the core analytical questions were answered incorrectly.
